title: Revenue and expenditure by year, every city, town and village in Niagara County, 1995–2025
notice: Self-reported annual filings to the NYS Comptroller: desk-reviewed by the Office of the State Comptroller, not audited. Figures as filed, no inflation adjustment, no year interpolated (a year with no filing is absent, never zero). The reporting basis changed in 2013: figures on either side of it are not strictly comparable.
